bulbasaur.description: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

ivysaur.description: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

venusaur.description: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

charmander.description: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

charmeleon.description: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

charizard.description: If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

squirtle.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

wartortle.description: Wartortle’s long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular among older people.

blastoise.description: It deliberately increases its body weight so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

caterpie.description: It releases a stench from its red antennae to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

metapod.description: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. The Pokémon quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

butterfree.description: It loves the nectar of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

weedle.description: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

kakuna.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

beedrill.description: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

pidgey.description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

pidgeotto.description: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

pidgeot.description: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

rattata.description: It’s cautious in the extreme, and its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

raticate.description: It whittles down its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder block walls.

spearow.description: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

fearow.description: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

ekans.description: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

arbok.description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

pikachu.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

raichu.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

sandshrew.description: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

sandslash.description: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

nidoranf.description: While this Pokémon does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the venom it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

nidorina.description: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow more slowly than Nidorino’s.

nidoqueen.description: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

nidoranm.description: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

nidorino.description: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes venom upon impact.

nidoking.description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

clefairy.description: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

clefable.description: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.

vulpix.description: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

ninetales.description: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

jigglypuff.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

wigglytuff.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

zubat.description: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

golbat.description: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

oddish.description: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

gloom.description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

vileplume.description: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

paras.description: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

parasect.description: Parasect is controlled by a mushroom that has grown larger than its host’s body. The Pokémon scatters poisonous spores.

venonat.description: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

venomoth.description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

diglett.description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

dugtrio.description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

meowth.description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

persian.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

psyduck.description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

golduck.description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

mankey.description: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

primeape.description: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

growlithe.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

arcanine.description: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

poliwag.description: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It appears more clearly after Poliwag eats.

poliwhirl.description: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

poliwrath.description: Although it’s skilled in a style of dynamic swimming that uses all its muscles, for some reason it lives on dry land.

abra.description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

kadabra.description: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.

alakazam.description: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

machop.description: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

machoke.description: Machoke’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

machamp.description: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

bellsprout.description: No matter what Bellsprout is doing, if it detects movement nearby, it will immediately react by reaching out with its thin vines.

weepinbell.description: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

victreebel.description: It lures prey into its mouth with a nectar-like aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

tentacool.description: When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool can be found left behind on the shore.

tentacruel.description: On the rare occasions that large outbreaks of Tentacruel occur, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.

geodude.description: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

graveler.description: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.

golem.description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

ponyta.description: About an hour after birth, Ponyta’s fiery mane and tail grow out, giving the Pokémon an impressive appearance.

rapidash.description: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

slowpoke.description: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

slowbro.description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

magnemite.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

magneton.description: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

farfetchd.description: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

doduo.description: Its twin heads have exactly the same genes and battle in perfect sync with each other.

dodrio.description: It now has three hearts and three sets of lungs. Though it can’t run as fast as Doduo, Dodrio can keep running for longer stretches of time.

seel.description: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

dewgong.description: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

grimer.description: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

muk.description: It’s thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

shellder.description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

cloyster.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

gastly.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

haunter.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

gengar.description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

onix.description: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

drowzee.description: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

hypno.description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

krabby.description: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.

kingler.description: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

voltorb.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

electrode.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

exeggcute.description: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

exeggutor.description: It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

cubone.description: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

marowak.description: The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

hitmonlee.description: At the exact moment it lands a kick on its target, Hitmonlee hardens the muscles on the sole of its foot, maximizing the power of the kick.

hitmonchan.description: It corners its foes with combo punches from both sides, then finishes them off with a single straight punch launched at over 300 mph.

lickitung.description: Instead of its hands, it uses its tongue, which can stretch to twice this Pokémon’s height. Lickitung’s sticky saliva grips anything.

koffing.description: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

weezing.description: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.

rhyhorn.description: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

rhydon.description: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

chansey.description: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

tangela.description: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

kangaskhan.description: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

horsea.description: If attacked—even by a large enemy—Horsea effortlessly swims to safety by utilizing its well-developed dorsal fin.

seadra.description: The male raises the young. If it is approached while caring for young, it will use its toxic spines to fend off the intruder.

goldeen.description: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

seaking.description: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. The Pokémon defends its eggs with its life.

staryu.description: If Staryu’s body is damaged, it will regenerate as long as the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

starmie.description: At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

mrmime.description: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

scyther.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

jynx.description: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

electabuzz.description: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

magmar.description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

pinsir.description: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn apart. What it can’t tear, it tosses far away.

tauros.description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

magikarp.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

gyarados.description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

lapras.description: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

ditto.description: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.

eevee.description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

vaporeon.description: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

jolteon.description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

flareon.description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

porygon.description: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

omanyte.description: It’s a Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

omastar.description: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

kabuto.description: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a sturdy shell.

kabutops.description: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

aerodactyl.description: It’s a Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

snorlax.description: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it’s asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

articuno.description: This legendary bird Pokémon can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

zapdos.description: This legendary Pokémon is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

moltres.description: It is one of the legendary bird Pokémon. Its appearance is said to indicate the coming of spring.

dratini.description: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

dragonair.description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

dragonite.description: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

mewtwo.description: Mewtwo was created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

mew.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

bayleef.description: The spicy scent that wafts from around Bayleef’s neck somehow makes those who smell it want to fight.

meganium.description: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

cyndaquil.description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

quilava.description: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

typhlosion.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur to cause huge explosions.

totodile.description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

croconaw.description: The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.

feraligatr.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

sentret.description: This Pokémon is extremely cautious. Its supple tail is well muscled and firm to the touch.

furret.description: It raises its offspring inside a long, narrow nest. Once they’re old enough, it takes them outside the nest to prepare them for independence.

hoothoot.description: Hoothoot’s internal clock is precise at all times. It tilts its head in a fixed rhythm.

noctowl.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

ledyba.description: It’s so timid that it can’t move unless it’s with a swarm. It conveys its feelings through scent.

ledian.description: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

spinarak.description: Even while there are prey ensnared in its nest of spun thread, Spinarak will wait motionlessly until darkness falls.

ariados.description: A single strand of a special thread is endlessly spun out of its rear. The thread leads back to its nest.

crobat.description: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

chinchou.description: It lives in ocean depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

lanturn.description: Portions of its dorsal fin mutated, becoming the parts that glow brightly to lure prey.

pichu.description: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

cleffa.description: On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.

igglybuff.description: Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.

togepi.description: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.

togetic.description: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called joy dust.

natu.description: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

xatu.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

mareep.description: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

flaaffy.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

ampharos.description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

bellossom.description: Due to the effects of the Sun Stone, it is now active during the daytime. It likes to dance in pools of sunlight.

marill.description: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

azumarill.description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

sudowoodo.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

politoed.description: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

hoppip.description: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

skiploom.description: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon’s head.

jumpluff.description: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

aipom.description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

sunkern.description: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

sunflora.description: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

yanma.description: As Yanma surveys its territory, it periodically stops to hover in place by flapping its wings at high speeds.

wooper.description: A transparent mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it bare-handed will cause a tingling numbness.

quagsire.description: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

espeon.description: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

umbreon.description: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

murkrow.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

slowking.description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

misdreavus.description: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

unown.description: Because the Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether written language or Unown came first.

wobbuffet.description: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. This behavior is said to be proof that its tail hides a secret.

girafarig.description: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

pineco.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.

forretress.description: It’s usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

dunsparce.description: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

gligar.description: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

steelix.description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

snubbull.description: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

granbull.description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

qwilfish.description: Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.

scizor.description: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

shuckle.description: It stores berries in its shell. The berries mix with its body fluids to become delicious juices.

heracross.description: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

sneasel.description: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

teddiursa.description: This Pokémon discreetly follows Combee to find their hive. It scoops up big dollops of honey in its palms to eat.

ursaring.description: It usually wears a hardened expression, but when it’s licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

slugma.description: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

magcargo.description: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

swinub.description: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn’t give it any trouble.

piloswine.description: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

corsola.description: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

remoraid.description: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

octillery.description: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

delibird.description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

mantine.description: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

skarmory.description: Its sturdy, heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

houndour.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

houndoom.description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

kingdra.description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

phanpy.description: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

donphan.description: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won’t faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

porygon2.description: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting- edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

stantler.description: This Pokémon apparently used to live in much harsher environments, and thus it once had stronger psychic powers than it does now.

smeargle.description: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

tyrogue.description: This earnest Pokémon battles all sorts of opponents, searching for the fighting style that suits it best.

hitmontop.description: This Pokémon is adept at dance-like kicks. The horn atop its head is made from the same substance that generally forms fur and claws.

smoochum.description: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

elekid.description: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish white when it is charging energy.

magby.description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, sparks leak from its mouth and nostrils.

miltank.description: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

blissey.description: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

raikou.description: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

entei.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

suicune.description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

larvitar.description: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

pupitar.description: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

tyranitar.description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

lugia.description: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

hooh.description: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

celebi.description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

ampharosmega.description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

scizormega.description: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

heracrossmega.description: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

houndoommega.description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

tyranitarmega.description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

steelixmega.description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

slowkinggalar.description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

corsolagalar.description: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

typhlosionhisui.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur to cause huge explosions.

qwilfishhisui.description: Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.

sneaselhisui.description: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

wooperpaldea.description: A transparent mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it bare-handed will cause a tingling numbness.

meganiummega.description: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

feraligatrmega.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

skarmorymega.description: Its sturdy, heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

treecko.description: The small hooks on the soles of its feet latch on to walls and ceilings, so it will never fall even while hanging upside down.

grovyle.description: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

sceptile.description: It agilely flits through the jungle and uses the sharp-edged leaves on its arms to cut down its prey.

torchic.description: Torchic feels toasty warm if you hug it. It has a flame sac inside its belly, and the flames burn continuously as long as Torchic has life in it.

combusken.description: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

blaziken.description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

mudkip.description: It has the power to crush large boulders into pieces. To rest, it buries itself in mud at the bottom of a river.

marshtomp.description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has served to train its lower body and caused it to develop sturdy legs.

swampert.description: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break an enormous boulder into pieces.

poochyena.description: It bares its large fangs and barks vigorously to try to intimidate opponents, but this is actually a manifestation of its cowardly nature.

mightyena.description: They faithfully follow the orders of their leader. Prey targeted by Mightyena is never allowed to escape the outstanding teamwork of its pursuers.

zigzagoon.description: It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

linoone.description: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

wurmple.description: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

silcoon.description: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

beautifly.description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

cascoon.description: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

dustox.description: Dustox are nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

lotad.description: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

lombre.description: Old folklore in Kitakami tells of a mischievous child who was reborn as a Pokémon.

ludicolo.description: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

seedot.description: To expand its habitat, it pretends to be a nut so that bird Pokémon will pick it up and carry it far away.

nuzleaf.description: It leads a quiet life deep in the forest. If anything wanders into its territory, Nuzleaf will warn the intruder by sounding its grass flute.

shiftry.description: It is said that when Shiftry flaps its leafy fans atop ancient trees, chilly winds blow and the season rolls into winter.

taillow.description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

swellow.description: It circles the sky in search of prey and dives sharply to catch its target.

wingull.description: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

pelipper.description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

ralts.description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

kirlia.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

gardevoir.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

surskit.description: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

masquerain.description: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

shroomish.description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

breloom.description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

slakoth.description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

vigoroth.description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

slaking.description: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

nincada.description: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

ninjask.description: Because they move so quickly, they sometimes become unseeable. They congregate around tree sap.

shedinja.description: It is a discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

whismur.description: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

loudred.description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

exploud.description: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

makuhita.description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

hariyama.description: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

azurill.description: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

nosepass.description: The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making this Pokémon an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

skitty.description: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in circles, chasing its own tail.

delcatty.description: It is highly popular among Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

sableye.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

mawile.description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

aron.description: It usually lives deep in mountains. But when it’s hungry, it shows up at the foot of the mountains and eats railroad tracks and cars.

lairon.description: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

aggron.description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

meditite.description: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

medicham.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

electrike.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

manectric.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

plusle.description: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

minun.description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

volbeat.description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

illumise.description: Illumise uses its sweet scent to guide Volbeat, having them form over 200 patterns in the night sky.

roselia.description: Roselia raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

gulpin.description: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

swalot.description: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

carvanha.description: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

sharpedo.description: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as the Bully of the Sea.

wailmer.description: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nostrils.

wailord.description: It’s the biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

numel.description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

camerupt.description: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

torkoal.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

spoink.description: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

grumpig.description: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

spinda.description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Their tottering steps hinder the aim of foes.

trapinch.description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

vibrava.description: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

flygon.description: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cacnea.description: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cacturne.description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

swablu.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

altaria.description: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

zangoose.description: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

seviper.description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

lunatone.description: It becomes active on nights with a full moon, so it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

solrock.description: This new Pokémon species is rumored to be an avatar of the sun. The Pokémon gives off light while spinning.

barboach.description: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

whiscash.description: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

corphish.description: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

crawdaunt.description: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

baltoy.description: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

claydol.description: An ancient clay figurine was exposed to a mysterious ray of light, and it came to life as a Pokémon.

lileep.description: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

cradily.description: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

anorith.description: This Pokémon ancestor was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with its claws.

armaldo.description: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

feebas.description: This tough Pokémon is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn’t popular.

milotic.description: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow- colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

castform.description: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

kecleon.description: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

shuppet.description: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

banette.description: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

duskull.description: In the dead of night, these Pokémon wander through towns in search of children, whose vital energy is a Duskull’s favorite food.

dusclops.description: Dusclops is feared because it’s said to pull the soul out of anyone who gazes upon the strange movements of its hands.

tropius.description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

chimecho.description: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

absol.description: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

wynaut.description: They grow strong by pushing up against one another en masse. They love eating sweet fruit.

snorunt.description: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

glalie.description: Its prey is instantaneously frozen stiff by the cold air it exhales from its huge mouth. While they’re in that frozen state, it gobbles them up.

spheal.description: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

sealeo.description: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

walrein.description: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold but also enemy attacks.

clamperl.description: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

huntail.description: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

gorebyss.description: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

relicanth.description: This rare Pokémon was discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

luvdisc.description: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

bagon.description: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

shelgon.description: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.

salamence.description: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up everything it passes over.

beldum.description: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

metang.description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

metagross.description: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

regirock.description: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, Regirock attaches rocks to repair itself.

regice.description: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of −328 degrees Fahrenheit.

registeel.description: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

latias.description: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

latios.description: It is a highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

kyogre.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

groudon.description: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

rayquaza.description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

jirachi.description: It is said to wake up for just seven days every 1,000 years and use its power to grant any wish.

turtwig.description: The shell on its back is made of soil. If the shell is moist to the touch, Turtwig is very healthy.

grotle.description: Grotle live in the forest. Each is said to have its own secret place for getting clean springwater.

torterra.description: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground dwelt a gigantic Torterra.

chimchar.description: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

monferno.description: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

infernape.description: This Pokémon confounds opponents with its speed. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

piplup.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

prinplup.description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

empoleon.description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them in two with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

starly.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

staravia.description: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

staraptor.description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

bidoof.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

bibarel.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

kricketot.description: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

kricketune.description: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

shinx.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

luxio.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

luxray.description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

budew.description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

roserade.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cranidos.description: It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.

rampardos.description: Stifled by a thick skull that can withstand any impact, this Pokémon’s brain never got very big.

shieldon.description: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it has no particular need to battle with others and can spend its time feeding on grass and berries.

bastiodon.description: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.

burmy.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

wormadam.description: When Burmy evolves, its cloak becomes a part of its body. Wormadam’s cloak is never shed.

mothim.description: It loves the nectar of flowers and steals nectar collected by Combee.

combee.description: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

vespiquen.description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

pachirisu.description: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

buizel.description: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

floatzel.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cherubi.description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

cherrim.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. The Pokémon tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

shellos.description: It used to have a shell on its back long ago. This species is closely related to Pokémon like Shellder.

gastrodon.description: Its whole body is sticky with mucus. In the past, this form of Gastrodon was by far the more numerous one.

ambipom.description: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

drifloon.description: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

drifblim.description: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

buneary.description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

lopunny.description: An extremely cautious Pokémon that cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

mismagius.description: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

honchkrow.description: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

glameow.description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

purugly.description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

chingling.description: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

stunky.description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

skuntank.description: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

bronzor.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

bronzong.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

bonsly.description: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

mimejr.description: It habitually mimics foes. The mimicked foe is said to be unable to look away from Mime Jr.

happiny.description: It carries a round, white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

chatot.description: They can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

spiritomb.description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

gible.description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

gabite.description: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

garchomp.description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

munchlax.description: It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it’s indifferent.

riolu.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

lucario.description: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

hippopotas.description: It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.

hippowdon.description: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

skorupi.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

drapion.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

croagunk.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

toxicroak.description: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

carnivine.description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat its prey.

finneon.description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

lumineon.description: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

mantyke.description: A friendly Pokémon that senses the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

snover.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

abomasnow.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

weavile.description: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

magnezone.description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

lickilicky.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

rhyperior.description: This Pokémon’s sturdy carapace protects it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round rocks from the holes in its hands.

tangrowth.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

electivire.description: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

magmortar.description: When shooting 3,600 degree Fahrenheit fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

togekiss.description: It will never appear where there is strife. Sightings of this Pokémon have recently become rare.

yanmega.description: Yanmega’s wingbeats are so powerful that the Pokémon blows down huge trees nearby when it vigorously launches itself into flight.

leafeon.description: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

glaceon.description: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

gliscor.description: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

mamoswine.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

porygonz.description: An additional program was installed to create a more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

gallade.description: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

probopass.description: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack a foe from three directions.

dusknoir.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and take them to the afterlife.

froslass.description: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.

rotom.description: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

uxie.description: Known as the Being of Knowledge, it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

mesprit.description: It is known as the Being of Emotion. It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

azelf.description: It is known as the Being of Willpower. It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

dialga.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

palkia.description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

heatran.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

regigigas.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

giratina.description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cresselia.description: When it flies, it releases shiny particles from its veil-like wings. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

phione.description: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

manaphy.description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

darkrai.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of a new moon.

shaymin.description: It lives in common flower patches but is rarely noticed. It is often mistaken for a flowering plant when curled up.

arceus.description: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
